PP16 1.0 - CREDITS AND REFERENCE NOTICES
======================================

PP16
Copyright (C) 2026 Bartholomew Harner. All rights reserved.
Designed and developed by Bartholomew Harner, with implementation assistance
from the OpenAI Codex AI assistant.

PP16 is an independent new implementation. PIXELplus 256 by Chris Chadwick
is a workflow and behaviour reference. PP16 does not contain its unavailable
editor source or supplied artwork and is not presented as the original work.
PIXELplus 256 Copyright (C) 1995 Chris Chadwick (Somerset, England).
The original PIXELplus package is not included in this distribution.

GRAFIX 2.60 Copyright (C) 1988-2005 by Joseph A. Albrecht
ADJMEM 1.1 Copyright 1989-2005 (C) by Joseph A. Albrecht

PP16's TVIDEO implementation adapts Mode 09h addressing, nibble and page
selection algorithms from GRAFIX 2.60. Its video-memory reservation is a new
DOS-allocation implementation informed by ADJMEM's reservation requirements.
No original TSR or Pascal object file from those packages is linked.

GRAFIX.DOC states:
"I am making GRAFIX public domain including all the source code. The only
thing I ask is that my name and copyright must be included no matter what
changes are made."

FREE PASCAL RUNTIME
The editor is built with Free Pascal 3.2.2 and links its runtime library.
FPCRTL.TXT contains the supplied COPYING.FPC runtime notice and exception.
COPYING.TXT contains the accompanying GNU Library General Public License.
These files are reproduced verbatim from the project's compiler package.
They describe the Free Pascal runtime; they do not replace PP16's copyright.

Project repository: https://github.com/GPhysty/PP16_DEV
